description: Image Description: The image depicts a room corner containing a vintage-style stove with a stovepipe extending upwards and curving into the wall. The stove is predominantly white with a dark top, and it has a few knobs and a door handle visible. Next to the stove, there is a makeshift wooden table with a colorful tablecloth. On the table, there are various household items, including a box and some folded fabrics or towels. The floor appears to be covered with a worn-out carpet.
